';
function run(cmd,args){cp.execFileSync(cmd,args,{stdio:'inherit'})}
fs.rmSync(tmp,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(tmp,{recursive:true});
run('curl',['-fL','--retry','3','--retry-delay','1',artifactUrl,'-o',tmp+'/artifact.zip']);
run('python3',['-c',"import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile('"+tmp+"/artifact.zip').extractall('"+tmp+"/zip')"]);
const find=(dir,pred)=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(dir,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){const x=find(p,pred);if(x)return x}else if(pred(p))return p}};
const tarball=find(tmp+'/zip',p=>/brain-management-mobile-.*\.tar\.gz$/.test(p));if(!tarball)throw Error('BASE_ARTIFACT_TAR_MISSING');
fs.mkdirSync(tmp+'/base',{recursive:true});run('tar',['-xzf',tarball,'-C',tmp+'/base']);fs.cpSync(tmp+'/base',root,{recursive:true,force:true});
const overlay=Buffer.from(nonjsonB64,'base64');if(crypto.createHash('sha256').update(overlay).digest('hex')!=='d48ad53e3169edc7a316d2425c00178fd47684ffc5938bb3aea7af3587c6cd92')throw Error('NONJSON_OVERLAY_HASH');
fs.writeFileSync(tmp+'/nonjson.tar',zlib.brotliDecompressSync(overlay));run('tar',['-xf',tmp+'/nonjson.tar','-C',root]);
const patchMap=JSON.parse(zlib.brotliDecompressSync(Buffer.from(patchesB64,'base64')).toString('utf8'));
function apply(obj,op){const [parts,kind,value]=op;let cur=obj;for(let i=0;i<parts.length-1;i++)cur=cur[parts[i]];const k=parts[parts.length-1];if(kind==='delete'){if(Array.isArray(cur))cur.splice(Number(k),1);else delete cur[k]}else if(parts.length===0)obj=value;else cur[k]=value;return obj}
for(const [rel,ops] of Object.entries(patchMap)){let obj=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,rel),'utf8'));for(const op of ops)obj=apply(obj,op);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(root,rel)),{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,rel),JSON.stringify(obj,null,2)+'\n')}
for(const f of fs.readdirSync(root))if(/^extract\.part\./.test(f)||f==='extract-release.js')fs.rmSync(path.join(root,f),{force:true});
const old=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'mobile-release-manifest.json'),'utf8'));
const files=[];function walk(dir){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(dir,e.name),rel=path.relative(root,p).replaceAll('\\','/');if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(rel!=='mobile-release-manifest.json'){const b=fs.readFileSync(p);files.push({path:rel,sha256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex'),bytes:b.length})}}}walk(root);files.sort((a,b)=>a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
const manifest={...old,schema_version:5,artifact_type:'BRAIN_MANAGEMENT_CANONICAL_RELEASE_BUNDLE',generated_at:new Date().toISOString(),source_sha:'2b267009cbf68b895b457e45d606c96d88d9ac2c',base_green_artifact_source_sha:'b7ee86f953547928bb88e7c53f514046c3a8613a',recovery_composition:'LAST_GREEN_FULL_DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE_PLUS_CURRENT_MAIN_ATOMIC_OPERATIONAL_SOURCE_AND_P0_GUARDS',operational_source_generated_at:'2026-08-05T04:10:30.000Z',service_worker_cache:'brain-management-v51',root_file_count:files.filter(x=>!x.path.includes('/')).length,file_count:files.length,files};
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,'mobile-release-manifest.json'),JSON.stringify(manifest,null,2)+'\n');
if(files.length<75)throw Error('REDUCED_RELEASE_BUNDLE_FORBIDDEN:'+files.length);
console.log('ATOMIC_RECOVERY_EXTRACTED',manifest.source_sha,manifest.file_count);
